title: Briefing for 2026-10-01
intro: Good morning. Here is your briefing for 2026-10-01: US markets, global news, and the Philippines, in five minutes.
us: China posts weakest industrial profit growth this year, expanding 4.2% in August. China saw 'surprise' jump in U.S. orders ahead of Trump-Xi summit, private survey shows. Surging Treasury yields pose a brand new problem for Kevin Warsh and the Fed. Global debt tops $365 trillion as economists sound alarm over 'vicious cycle'. Switzerland is keeping rates at 0% — for now. France's fresh budget battle threatens to topple another government.
global: Six smugglers jailed for manslaughter over worst Channel small boats disaster. Trekkers helicoptered off mountains as more deadly landslides hit Nepal. Russia launches largest attack on Ukraine energy infrastructure since spring. Last UK and US troops leave Iraq as anti-Islamic State mission ends. Three takeaways from Trump's 'Super Intelligence' summit. Doubters spur me on: why more women are taking up DIY.
philippines: It takes a village: Lady’s Choice leads a parent-kid-school partnership for healthier kids. SC junks petitions vs conviction voting threshold | The wRap. EJ Obiena ‘reborn’ after record-breaking Asian Games triumph. In the Public Square: Taking the fight to the dynasties.
outro: That's your briefing. Have a great day.
